finder.note: Ranks one-contract positions only within the selected expirations and the nearest 32 usable strikes per option type to the midpoint of current and target prices. Results assume the entered target price/date and volatility; they are not forecasts. Maximum risk is the full expiration loss, not broker margin. Probability is a risk-neutral model estimate at expiration.
